title: Cotton gray handtowels
text: Cotton gray handtowels. In my opinion, thick and soft... a medium weight.  They washed up nicely.  The gray is a darker. I think a bit darker than pictured.  I am using them at our laundry room sick, so darker is better in my mind. I purchased in a 4 pack and I think the pricing was comparable to local availability, however, these were delivered to my door.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Towels 4 Piece Luxury Bath Towels Set, (27 x 54 Inches) 100% Ring Spun Cotton 600GSM, Lightweight and Highly Absorbent Quick Drying Towels for Bathroom, Gym, Spa, and Hotel (Grey)
